notes.title: WHO IS AWESOME Released!
notes.content:
[b]WHO IS AWESOME[/b] is a singleplayer mini-game collection, in which the most awesome character that you choose competes with the characters that you didn’t.

Four characters from different games — Reaper from [b]Peace, Death![/b], Vladimir from [b]DRAW CHILLY[/b], Knight from [b]OH MY GOD, LOOK AT THIS KNIGHT![/b], and the Cowboy from [b]Gun Done[/b] — sit at the same table and try to think faster than their opponents.

[h1]The game has only two rules[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rule number one: if you lose, the others will win.
[*]Rule number two: if you win, the others will lose.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wJLAZgyuT4

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33751114/284122d972716b43603ab595a52890ef50db06e6.png[/img]

notes.title: Difficulty and gameplay
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33085224/de06930f0232f5efed2df01ab9c66a7fe3d83d35.jpg[/img]
Yaw, Vlads!
Here's a little patch from the General with a few changes.

[list]
[*] Difficulty now affects the bosses.
[*] Forgiving difficulty. It's a bit easier, than before.
[*] Hard difficulty. I call it "Classic", cause it's very close to classic difficulty. BEFORE THIS NERF! But bosses enrages earlier.
[*] Excruciating difficulty. Meh. Do not use.
[*] 20% more abilities for Vladimir, cause Delivery Chickens now is faster.
[*] Added video with gameplay on the game’s page. The current Vlads are not affected.
[/list]

notes.title: Mouse patch
notes.content:
Now you can assign mouse buttons: left, right and middle.
Weird. Use gamepad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33085224/0866fbf58db1a1ae7df271d29cc7da10b4aa6f48.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nerfs and Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Gorrilla bus: Descreased the amount of enemies in the bus. Sad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33085224/d6593c1a47ba83e5f80837f756f630677fc949f2.png[/img]

notes.title: Settings - User Interface
notes.content:
User interface changes. You can turn the new functions on and off in Settings > Interface in any time.
[list]
[*]User Interface. Enemies health bars. (on/off). Default: On.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33085224/39a8169d83c646f0d088a9382e26796227377c3f.png[/img]

[*]User Interface. VladCoins in top right corner are permanent now. (on/off).  Default: On.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33085224/8c0bb2000fe225bf7ff221ee8dc93d87f083a14b.png[/img]

[*]User Interface. If you lose Vladimir, there's a new "Mark of the Vladimir" option (on/off).  Default: Off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33085224/a908033b2fe24dd346f24acb7e517be5002eaef8.png[/img]
[/list]

Ability changes
[list]
[*]Ability: Taxi. Damage increased.

[*]Abilites. Now, if you pick up the ability item, it not replaces the current one, like previosly. But, if you pick up ability item first time after unlocking, it replaces current one, as before.
[/list]
